name: Decaf Ethiopia Uraga (SWP)
notes: Lively decaf with refined sweetness like brown-sugar simple syrup: honey, lemon black tea, chocolate malted grain, cherry cordial, lemongrass. Clean washed Ethiopian character. Medium body.

name: Decaf Colombia Santa Barbara (MWP)
notes: Economical, crowd-pleasing; good body and flavour, can pass for non-decaf. Sweet, clean aftertaste, angel food cake, maybe a little caramel.

name: Ethiopia Dry Process Buku Abel
notes: Cleanly fruited natural: mango and ripe papaya, jellied berries, chai/cinnamon/star anise spice, artisanal chocolate at City+, exceptionally sweet finish.

name: Rwanda Washed Rwamiko Washing Station (Crown Jewel)
process: Washed, low intervention (floated, sorted, overnight ferment, 24 h soak, raised beds)
notes: Bright and tropical: orange peel, lemon curd, passion fruit, then persimmon and lemongrass; silky texture, black tea, apricot and honey in the brew.

name: Kenya Kiambu Spike Peaberry
notes: Very sweet at light and medium roasts: complex burnt sugars, blackberry tea, plum, dark orange, dried currant, spice in the finish. More fruited than the AB lot. City brings dark berry and stone fruit; Full City darker fruit and chocolate bittersweet.

name: Ethiopia Dry Process Bobea Uke
notes: Berry-toned sweetness, passion fruit, dried peach, tea-like bittering, whole spices, chocolate-covered fruit; strawberry, blackberry, mango, floral hints.

name: Ethiopia Duromina Aba Bulgu
notes: Syrupy honey sweetness with aromatic fruits and citrus: juicy stone fruit, ripe strawberry, mango, lemon Italian ice, hibiscus tea, peach, apricot tea, orange blossom.

name: Decaf Indonesia Sumatra (MWP)
process: Mountain Water Process decaf (Mexico); Fair Trade, Organic
notes: Supplier's favourite decaf: more body and flavour than other origins, less bitter and more flavourful than Swiss Water; dark, full-bodied, rich, smooth mug.

name: Kenya Nyeri Mutheka AB
process: Washed (wet process, Kenya type), raised bed sun-dried
notes: Juicy texture, apple, pomegranate, Turkish Delight candies, brown sugar, golden raisin, sweet citrus; acidity present but not prominent (malic apple), tea-like finish. Full City: dark chocolate, red berry; good espresso.
